BiblicalUsage: Shophak was the captain of Hadarezer's host, the same Syrian commander Samuel calls Shobak. The Syrians drew their forces from beyond the river, Israel put them to the worse, and David slew seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophak on the field.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same man under two spellings is still one man God judged. Shophak's army was great, and I hold that greatness without the Lord is only a larger defeat.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
